statement.p: Contestants A, B, C, D, E, F, and G are in a 10K race.
(a) How many different ways can a race with 7 runners be completed? (Assume there is no tie.)
(b) In how many ways can D finish first and E finish second?
(c) What is the probability that D finishes first and E finishes second? Give the probability as a fraction or a decimal rounded to four decimal places.
